title: GCP Marketplace submission checklist (requirements, artifacts, and review milestones)
creator: Chris Osei
description:
Goal
- Capture a single, actionable checklist for GCP Marketplace submission (SaaS listing) covering: required listing fields, mandatory artifacts, security/compliance package expectations, and review milestones.
- This checklist is the source-of-truth for go/no-go readiness for the GCP portion of the Marketplace Listing Refresh.

Owners / reviewers
- DRI (PMM): Soojin Lee
- Program coordination: Chris Osei
- Security/GRC reviewers: Naomi Feldman (security/compliance PO), Dr. Aisha Rahman (exec sponsor), Olga Petrov (GRC lead)
- Docs reviewers: Alex Martinez, Elliot Price
- Engineering reviewers (onboarding + metering): Chloe Martin (console), Cole Summers (billing/metering), Ethan Park (control plane)
- Partnerships/GTM reviewer: Stephanie Nguyen (enterprise), Lukas Meyer (EMEA)

References
- PRD: confluence/product-docs/requirements/cloud-marketplace-listing-refresh-prd
- Packaging/SKUs: confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/marketplace-sku-catalog-v2
- GCP billing semantics: confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/gcp-marketplace-sku-and-billing-dimensions
- Onboarding flow spec: confluence/product-docs/design-specs/marketplace-subscription-to-org-provisioning-flow
- Security packet index: confluence/security-and-compliance/compliance-evidence/marketplace-security-documentation-pack
- Draft listing copy (working): drive/go-to-market/gcp-listing-copy-draft-v2
- Partner artifacts thread: slack/partnerships/1769453320-gcp-listing-required-artifacts

Submission type / constraints (assumptions to validate)
- Listing type: SaaS (Redwood-hosted control plane + inference service) with Marketplace entitlement → Redwood org provisioning.
- Billing: Usage-based dimensions mapped from Redwood internal meters (tokens/requests/seat-like add-ons if applicable) via marketplace dimensions.
- Regions: Must match actual service availability and any residency commitments stated in data handling docs.

Checklist A — GCP listing fields (portal form)
1) Basic listing info
- Product name + short tagline aligned to approved positioning (no unapproved competitive claims).
- Category selection and keywords.
- Provider/support contact details (support email alias + escalation route).
- Product URLs: docs landing page, marketplace onboarding guide, status page, privacy policy, terms.

2) Long description (must include)
- Clear differentiation: Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private (and how marketplace purchase maps).
- How it works (high-level): Subscribe → Entitlement → Redwood org provision/link → Create API key → Metering/invoicing.
- Key features: performance (latency/throughput), reliability/fallback, observability, rollouts/evals, cost controls.
- Buyer clarity: what’s included/excluded per SKU; any minimums/commitments if using private offers.

3) Pricing / plan presentation
- SKU names exactly match approved conventions (and consistent across AWS/GCP where possible).
- Each SKU has: inclusions, usage dimensions, and any add-ons (e.g., compliance package, advanced retention, premium SLA).
- Statement on trials/credits: only if approved by Finance/GTM and actually supported in marketplace flow.

4) Support & SLA statements
- Supported channels: support portal/email, severity definitions, response targets (only what we can honor).
- Link to support policy doc (public or gated) and “marketplace support routing” FAQ.

Checklist B — Mandatory artifacts (submission attachments)
1) Visual assets
- Logo(s) in required sizes/format.
- 3–6 screenshots: Console onboarding (marketplace entry), API key creation, usage/cost dashboard, audit logs view (if available), model catalog/routing policy.
- At least one architecture diagram: Marketplace → Entitlement service → Redwood control plane → inference runtime → telemetry/metering.

2) Documentation links (must be final URLs)
- Marketplace onboarding guide (GCP-specific steps + troubleshooting entitlement delays).
- Security overview suitable for marketplace review.
- Data handling and retention (customer-facing wording).
- Audit logging overview and export options.
- Status page + incident communication policy (if referenced).

3) Legal/commercial
- Terms of service URL and any marketplace-specific terms.
- Privacy policy URL (explicitly addresses processing of prompts/outputs/telemetry at a high level).
- Refund/credit handling statement (consistent with Finance guidance for marketplace).

Checklist C — Security & compliance artifacts (marketplace review expectations)
1) Marketplace security overview (public summary)
- Shared responsibility model (what Redwood controls vs customer controls).
- Data flow narrative (what is processed; where it is stored; how long; who can access).
- Encryption in transit and at rest (include KMS/HSM integration statement only if supported for the relevant SKU/deployment).
- Audit logging: events captured + retention + export to SIEM.

2) Evidence pointers (gated or on-request)
- SOC 2 Type II summary letter or appropriate attestation pathway (per GRC guidance).
- ISO posture statement if applicable (must be reviewed by Olga/Legal).
- Pen test summary / vulnerability management overview (high-level).
- Subprocessor list and change notification policy (if published).

3) Data handling specifics
- Default retention and configurable retention controls.
- Residency/region commitments: avoid overpromising “EU-only” unless enforced in product + contract.
- Model/prompt handling: do not state “we never store prompts” unless universally true; use approved language (e.g., “retention is configurable; logs may include metadata; prompts can be excluded from logs depending on settings”).

Checklist D — Fulfillment + onboarding validation (pre-submission test plan)
1) Entitlement and provisioning
- Confirm GCP subscription event → entitlement record visible to Redwood entitlement verification endpoint.
- Console flow supports: new org, existing org link, multi-subscription edge cases.
- Expected propagation delays documented + user-facing retry guidance.

2) Metering correctness
- Dimension IDs in GCP match Redwood internal meters (ENG-22111).
- Reconciliation plan: how we validate first invoices vs internal usage for first 5 test accounts.
- Negative tests: wrong SKU, expired entitlement, suspended subscription.

3) Observability and support readiness
- Telemetry events for funnel steps emitted (subscription detected, org linked, key created, first successful request).
- Support macros drafted for: entitlement delay, org linking conflict, billing dimension confusion.

Checklist E — Review milestones & gates
Milestone 0: Pre-flight (internal)
- Copy approval by PMM + Partnerships (Soojin + Stephanie/Lukas) with security wording review (Naomi/Marcus).
- SKU catalog frozen for submission (or explicitly tracked as “post-launch change”).
- Final URLs locked (docs redirects completed if needed).

Milestone 1: Partner readiness
- All mandatory fields filled in staging draft listing.
- Attachments uploaded with correct formats and no confidential material.
- Security packet links verified and accessible as intended (public vs gated).

Milestone 2: GCP partner review round 1
- Track feedback in partner review tracker; assign owners and due dates.
- Common expected feedback categories to be ready for:
  - Security claims wording adjustments
  - Missing diagrams/screenshots
  - Support/SLA clarity
  - Billing dimension naming/units

Milestone 3: GCP partner review round 2 (if needed)
- All “must fix” items resolved.
- Re-validate onboarding flow in the latest build (console + entitlement sync reliability).

Milestone 4: Launch readiness / go-no-go
Go criteria
- Listing approved OR approval date committed by GCP with no open blocking items.
- Metering validation completed in at least one end-to-end test subscription.
- Docs published and linked; support routing live; escalation path confirmed.
- Security final sign-off: Naomi + Olga.
No-go criteria
- Any mismatch between GCP dimensions and internal meters.
- Security statements not backed by documented controls.
- Onboarding flow has unresolved P0 edge cases (existing org linking / delayed entitlement failure loops).

Open questions (to resolve before submission)
- Which SKUs are included in GCP at launch (Hosted only vs Hosted + Dedicated + Private request flow)? Confirm with Jordan/Finance if Dedicated/Private require private offers and how that is presented.
- Whether “Compliance add-on” is purchasable as a separate dimension vs packaged into an enterprise SKU.
- Final decision on trial/credits language for GCP Marketplace.

Action items (next 7–10 days)
- Soojin: finalize the “required artifacts” list with exact filenames and final URLs (coordinate with Elliot/Alex for docs).
- Naomi/Olga: confirm what evidence can be linked publicly vs gated (and the approved wording).
- Cole/Nadia: confirm final dimension IDs and units; provide a one-pager mapping for Support.
- Chloe: confirm console onboarding copy for GCP-specific flow + error states.

Notes
- Keep language consistent across: listing, docs site, security packet, and sales enablement. If we must weaken/adjust a claim for marketplace, update the “approved copy blocks” and propagate to AWS listing too to avoid inconsistency.
